opening.argument: The video presents a practical procedure for contacting Facebook when the support button is unavailable. It asks viewers to follow a stated process, including filling out and submitting a feedback form to Facebook, rather than directing them toward payment or disclosure of sensitive information. The subject is also framed as helping people contact Facebook, consistent with an instructional support explanation. Although the video includes a separate invitation to subscribe, that ordinary channel-engagement prompt is not connected to any financial or credential-related offer. The described 24-hour response is presented as part of the support-contact procedure, not as a payment or access scheme.
